body:
weight: light
tier: 0
charter: C5

Write the node policy that the run loop (T9) wraps every build in, against the pinned tool versions recorded in specs/factory-step2-v1/records/TB0.md and docs/adr/0005-run-loop-cli-reality.md: vetto 0.6.5 (sandbox; a policy file is passed with `--policy <PATH>`, network with `--net off|allowlist:<domains>`), ralon 0.1.7 (rails path lock; reads `agent.lock` from the directory given by `-C <dir>`, YAML `protect:` patterns relative to that file), dcg v0.15.3 (destructive-command hook; `dcg test --dialect posix`, config via `DCG_CONFIG` / `dcg test -c <path>`). Read each tool's `--help` before using a flag; never invent one (code to the real CLI, record differences in ADR-0005).

Deliverables:
- `factory/policy/build.toml`: vetto policy for test and build steps. Denies all network; writes only to the worktree (`$PROJECT`) and the dependency cache.
- `factory/policy/agent.toml`: vetto policy for model turns. Egress only to the adapter's API domain (claude-code: the hosts fleet 1.12.0's claude-code adapter declares as egressHosts: api.anthropic.com, console.anthropic.com, platform.claude.com).
- `factory/bin/lib/ralon-lock.sh`: renders the ralon lock for ticket <id> from the ticket's `rails` globs (read with `npx -y @adlc/cli@1.12.0 ticket show <id> --json`) into the format ralon 0.1.7 documents; `--dry-run` prints it, otherwise writes it as `agent.lock` at the root of the worktree it protects (ralon patterns are relative to the lock file and refuse `..`, so the lock cannot live under `.ralon/`; ADR-0005 decision 1), kept out of `git status` through the repository's `info/exclude`. Each rail glob is rendered both as itself and under `.worktrees/*/`, because fleet cuts its worker worktrees beneath its own working directory. A ticket with no rails renders a lock that still protects `factory/policy/**` (an empty agent.lock is refused by ralon by design).
- `factory/policy/dcg.toml` (or the config format dcg v0.15.3 documents, per `dcg config schema`) for the shell hook.
- `factory/policy/adapters.json` (ruling Q5 of specs/factory-step1-v1/RULINGS.md): pins claude-code to the version `claude --version` reports on the dev box, and every other fleet 1.12.0 adapter (codex, gemini, agy, jetski, opencode, pi, cursor, copilot) to `null`, which means "not pinned yet: refuse to claim with it".
- `factory/bin/version-check.sh` reads adapters.json; its JSON output's `pins_source` is no longer null.
- `make live` target: runs `tests/live/*.sh`; each prints `SKIP <reason>` and exits 0 only when a needed tool is absent. `make test` never runs a live test and stays offline, keyless and tool-free (fakes under tests/fakes/ for vetto, ralon and dcg, each recording its argv, each with its own behaviour test).

Acceptance criteria:
1. The lock renderer maps rails globs to the ralon lock format, always protects `factory/policy/**`, rejects a glob ralon would refuse (`..`, absolute, `~`, `!`) with exit 2, and is dry-run by default. Verify: `make test` (tests/test_policy.sh, case 'lock-render').
2. adapters.json validates against its schema: every fleet 1.12.0 adapter name is a key, values are an exact x.y.z string or null, and version-check.sh refuses to claim with a null-pinned adapter. Verify: `make test` (tests/test_policy.sh case 'adapters-schema', tests/test_version_check.sh).
3. build.toml denies `curl https://example.com`, allows a write inside the worktree and denies a write outside it. Verify: `make live` (tests/live/test_policy_live.sh), output pasted into the row's records.
4. agent.toml allows the adapter domain and denies another domain. Verify: `make live`.
5. ralon denies a write to a rail path and allows a write to a non-rail path. Verify: `make live`.
6. vetto refuses to start with a malformed profile (fail-closed, non-zero exit, the command never runs). Verify: `make live`.
7. Every new shell file is shellcheck -S warning clean. Verify: `make lint`.

Out of scope: wiring the policies into the run loop (T9); the join wizard's install step (T7).
title: Write the node policy: vetto sandbox profiles, the ralon rails lock, the dcg hook, adapter pins
